environment.note: The authors' JAX 0.3.16 wheel was unavailable from the configured package index; the earliest available compatible CPU stack was used without modifying the official FSDE source.

protocol: Task 1 complete posterior initialization; at online week t, only complete labels through t-1 train the official FSDE-SVI model; the official 52-output Gaussian predictive distribution is then analytically conditioned on the 42 legal current visible labels before predicting the ten hidden locations.

capacity.selection: shared LMC/IMC choice, validated by the same chronological Task-1 48-week history plus four held-out Setting B weeks

reporting_rule: No partial archive is inserted into the formal five-seed Gaussian table. A full FSDE-SVI result requires a dedicated long-running CPU or compatible GPU allocation.
